answer: Each challenge is derived from a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so its unpredictable output cannot be known when agents commit and cannot be selected by one participant. Domain-separated inputs such as crystal, prism, and walnut prevent cross-task reuse; commit-reveal and public verification expose withheld or altered responses. This blocks advance challenge precomputation and makes offline sybil farming unproductive, while any resource or identity limits must be enforced separately.
